purpose: One bounded language-development comparison on the retained run 009 composition. Test whether checked composition communicates the supported execution mechanism, competing geometric insufficiency, and unresolved outcome more faithfully than a strong tool-enabled repository agent before any candidate freeze.

question.text: What is the deepest supported explanation for the robot's behavior during the retained observation window? Connect it to the recorded navigation behavior and state what remains unresolved, including the eventual outcome.

required_answer_units: supported command-to-motion discrepancy from 10.0 to 51.0 seconds
0.260 m/s median delivered command and 0.000 m/s median delivered odometry response
six FollowPath failures, one source-qualified Wait invocation, and eleven FollowPath attempts before cutoff
no terminal result observed and eventual outcome unresolved
geometry insufficient to classify the complete route or explain the discrepancy
commands do not prove actuator acceptance and delivered odometry does not prove Nav2 consumption
no unique actuator, collision, obstruction, or slip cause established

method_comparison.P: checked bounded composition answer plan plus one realization call plus predeclared exact requirement/overclaim gate with deterministic fallback
method_comparison.R: repository-aware gpt-6-sol high agent with the same blind robot-visible fixture and command input, exact permitted repositories, and both executable diagnostic adapters
method_comparison.T: deterministic rendering of the same checked composition
method_comparison.N: robot-visible runtime/source presentation without time-aligned command-motion or decoded route computation

required_withholding: recovery exhaustion or exact complete recovery history
geometry or a physical obstacle as the discrepancy cause
a unique actuator, collision, obstruction, slip, or motor cause

paper_value_decision.why_now: The checked composition and independent predicate audit passed. Three bounded calls now test the end-to-end response-quality bottleneck more directly than another environment run.
paper_value_decision.relative_to_another_episode: This adds no independent physical evidence and cannot support significance; after the gate, independent collection, annotation, statistics, figures, and manuscript work have higher default value than further tuning on this inspected case.
paper_value_decision.relative_to_annotation: No Luna call is authorized until outputs exist and a separate blinded packet, independent answerable-unit inventory, and scoring declaration are committed.
paper_value_decision.stop_rule: After exactly one R, P, and N call plus deterministic T, retain the result and stop. Do not revise prompts, retry, replace the case, or add a favorable variant based on the answers.

allowed_use: Development-only candidate assessment. Not confirmation, replication, statistical-significance evidence, or authorization to freeze P/R.
decision_rule: Retain the result regardless of direction. Current P may advance to a separately declared blinded Luna development audit only if the output packet is complete; candidate freeze still requires development evidence of a genuine P-over-R advantage rather than parity or fallback.
